analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – focuses on practical AI skills and creator empowerment. However, ‘personal AI mentor’ and ‘global fluency challenge’ are somewhat vague.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Good – addresses a significant need for upskilling in the face of rapid AI adoption. Target users are well-defined.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Moderate – has a defined timeline, but relies heavily on prototypes and lacks concrete details on technical implementation. ‘Monthly updates’ aren’t a strong indicator of progress.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Unclear – micro-courses and enterprise programs suggest potential revenue, but monetization strategy isn’t detailed. Market size is limited but passionate.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Weak – lacks a concrete timeline, relies heavily on proposed testing and feedback, and doesn’t demonstrate a clear path to manufacturing.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Simple – direct sales of the bottle opener.
